claims.citation: New York Herald, 19 September 1866, p. 8, col. 6
New York Herald, 21 September 1866, p. 3, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
left Liverpool at half-past two on the afternoon of the
5th and Queenstown on the 6th September, arrived at
this port early yesterday morning.
Our European files are dated to the 8th inst., and con-
tain very interesting details of our despatches by the
Atlantic Cable to that day.

Steamship England (Br.), Grace, Liverpool Sept. 5, Queenstown
6th, with mdse. and 614 pass. to the National Steam Navigation Com-
pany. Sept. 11, lat. 50 14 N., long. 32 13 W., spoke ship Tara bound W.;
12th, passed ship Eliza McLaughlin, from Belfast for Quebec, 17 days
out.
